# Phaser Scale & Responsive

Curated by Skill Harbor — a deep reference skill for responsive design in Phaser 4: the ScaleManager's three size components (gameSize, baseSize, displaySize), all scale modes (NONE, FIT, ENVELOP, RESIZE, EXPAND) with when-to-use guidance, centering modes, zoom factors including MAX_ZOOM for pixel art, mobile orientation handling, fullscreen toggling with gotchas (pointerup not pointerdown, iframe allowfullscreen), plus a full ScaleConfig reference, event catalog, API quick reference and a source-file map into the Phaser codebase. Ships from the official Phaser account, so the source paths map to the real repo. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @phaserjs. Honest caveats: Phaser 4 specific — internal paths (src/scale/...) match that codebase; covers one subsystem only, pair it with the sibling game-setup skill for a full game; pure reference material, no runnable game code. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
